text:
aisha: Heads-up: proposing to onboard sylph-7b for embeddings + chat. It's a memory-efficient 7B variant. Need a rollout plan and quant experiments.

 tom: Sounds good. Target SLOs?

 aisha: SLOs: p50 token latency <50ms for small prompts on hosted; embeddings throughput ~10k req/day. Cost target ~ $0.0007/token.

 sanjay: For dedicated/private we need to check GPU compatibility. Int8 looks promising but try int4 as a stress test. I'll run quick benches on A100 and T4. @tom can you add eval sets?

 tom: On it. Eval checklist: summarization (news/longform), instruction-following (2-shot), safety/toxicity gating, and embedding sim drift. Keep per-task thresholds and a small human review sample.

 sanjay: Quick repro command I'm using:
```
run_quant_bench --model sylph-7b --profile int8 --batch 8 --seq 1024 --report csv
```

 jordan: Canary proposal: hosted 1% traffic for 24h, monitor latency, error-rate, and quality regressions (auto-alert on +2% loss in eval score). If stable -> 10% for 12h -> 50%. Include explicit rollback triggers.

 aisha: Fallback plan must be explicit: automatic fallback to sylph-7b-fp16 or to older model nightingale-7b-lite on quality or infra regressions. Define triggers (error spikes, p95 latency >200ms, eval drop >1.5%).

 sanjay: Routing snippet I'll push to config repo:
```
routes:
  - match: embeddings
    model: sylph-7b-embed-int8
    rollout: 0.05
  - match: chat
    model: sylph-7b-chat-int8
    rollout: 0.01
fallback:
  - sylph-7b-fp16
```

 tom: For quant evals: run embedding-similarity baseline vs fp16, drift threshold cosine <= 0.02. For generation, run ROUGE/BLEU + human spot-checks on 100 stratified samples across user intents. Capture failure modes (hallucination, instruction-ignore).

 vela-bot: deploy scheduled: canary window 2026-03-21T16:00:00Z -> 2026-03-22T04:00:00Z. I will post auto-telemetry (latency/cost/errors) to #eng-ml and create a temporary dashboard.

 sanjay: I'll start bench runs tonight and post numbers. If int8 drops instruction-following >1% we'll hold and test int8 mixed-fp16.

 aisha: Ownership recap: aisha (PM) - overall, tom (evals), sanjay (deploy/infra), jordan (SRE), vela-bot (automation). Target kickoff tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
